mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_wecom_kf_pending_message (message_id, open_kf_id, external_user_id, payload_json) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{openKfId}, #{externalUserId}, #{payloadJson})

INSERT INTO t_wecom_kf_message_retry (message_id, failure_count, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, 1, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 15 SECOND)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_retry_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(900, 15 * POW(2, LEAST(failure_count, 6))), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), failure_count = LEAST(failure_count + 1, 6)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(failure_count), 0) FROM t_wecom_kf_message_retry WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
